items.reason: A gentle, active-free cleanser that removes excess oil without stripping oily skin that is also low on moisture.
A gentle azelaic acid cream that helps even the look of redness and blemish-prone skin and is commonly considered suitable during pregnancy.
A ceramide moisturizer to support the skin barrier and comfort without feeling heavy.
A mineral SPF 50 for daily protection that is gentle on blemish-prone, redness-prone skin.

response.routine_note: Cleanse morning and night, apply the azelaic acid cream and moisturizer in the evening, and finish with mineral SPF each morning. I left out the strongest benzoyl peroxide wash, retinoids and strong exfoliants because pregnancy calls for extra caution, so please check with your prenatal provider or a dermatologist about severe breakouts.
